question_text: Construct day_summary(hours, temperatures) in Python. Both parallel lists contain 24 observations, one per hour 0..23. Define night as 20:00 through 05:59 inclusive. Return(maximum, minimum, overall mean, night mean). Use explicit comparisons and accumulation, not min, max or sum.
adaptation_rationale: Retains multi statistic parallel-list traversal; repairs source cross-midnight condition with OR, counts night observations, and uses safe extrema initialization.

marking_points.criterion: Initializes extrema from an actual temperature.
Initializes total, night total and night count.
Traverses every matched hour/temperature exactly once.
Identifies night using hour>=20 OR hour<6.
Accumulates the night values and counts exactly those observations.
Calculates both means with true division and returns all four results after traversal.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
